class EmbeddingConfig(BaseModel):
    """Embedding 配置;api_key/base_url 留空时回退到 LLM 的对应值。"""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    model: str
    schema_dimensions: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1)
    request_dimensions: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1)
    max_tokens: int = DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MAX_TOKENS
    api_key: str | None = Field(default=None, repr=False)
    base_url: str | None = None
    timeout: int = 60
    max_retries: int = 3
